title: Positional-binding contract's third leg — committed sprites.json 'order' — unpinned by gate 7
evidence:
GEN = ROOT / "tools" / "gen_sprites.py"
ODIN = ROOT / "app" / "render" / "sprites.odin"
--- the gate's own docstring: "sprites_load binds texture[i] to files[i] and bbox[i] to order[i] POSITIONALLY" — yet order[i] comes from sprites.json: ---
	order, oko := obj["order"].(json.Array)
	boxes, okb := obj["content_bbox"].(json.Object)
...
			sh.bboxes[i][k] = f32(n)
detail: The renderer binds bboxes[i] to the #load-embedded sprites.json order[i], but gate 7 compares only two of the three arrays. A stale or hand-edited sprites.json passes gate 7 green and mis-crops sprites; only the T2 pixel diff backstops — the bless-corrupt-crops failure mode B1 addressed.
recommended_fix: Extend test_sprite_order.py to parse assets/sprites/sprites.json 'order' and assert equality with files[] — pure JSON text, no Blender needed; land before the follow-up re-render/T2 re-bless.
